discription: A resonant low-pass filtered saw wave synthesizer with a controllable ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.01, decay=0.1, sustain=0.8, release=1.0, cutoff=4000, rq=0.5; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
